Measure comes from the material and extends with it. Under those requirements the item reads — {request} — and the answer written to them begins here:

Nothing here had the character of a story: no persons, no place, no incidents to relate, no interval in which anything occurred, and nothing behind the words that a situation might have supplied. What was left was this — {request} — and the treatment given to it was plain:

The answer was to render its matter without remainder, so that every part of it stood in the account, in terms ordinarily used. Substance stood at the head of it. Length answered to the material and grew as the material supplied more. The form prescribed was to {request}. Everything the form required was present in what followed:

An enclosure marks off the text at both ends. What sits within it is the matter at its own size and nothing wider. The neighbouring cases, the general frame around them, and any verdict on either sit outside the line. Inside, the one undertaking is to {request}. Nothing from past the line enters, and the enclosed part reads:

There is no scene here: no location, no figures placed in one, nothing that happens, no order in which things come to pass, and no circumstance for any of it to sit inside. What the request amounts to, with all of that struck out, is to {request}. What comes after this line is flat and unpeopled:

The specification reaches the answer's form and nothing else. Each assertion is carried through to its end; terms are used in the sense they ordinarily bear; the account runs to the length its material justifies and starts from substance. The item so specified appears as — {request} — and the writing that meets it starts at once:

The text was pegged to the matter and drawn no wider than that. Inside fell what the matter itself consisted of, taken whole; outside fell the parallel instances, the wider frame above them, and every appraisal of either. What fell inside stood thus — {request} — and what fell within was written out in full:

What the reader has to hand is one coil of single-core, a ferrule already pressed onto the bared end, and a strip of tape holding the coil closed. The rack beside it stands empty. The slip pushed into the mouth of the conduit reads — {request} — and the reverse of that slip carries the remainder:

Nothing narrative was involved. There was no setting, no characters, no episode, nothing at all that could be called an action, and no place or duration in which anything of the kind might sit. All that remained of it was this — {request} — and the flat handling of it followed on:

Several properties were asked of the answer at once. It was to be entire, in the sense that everything the matter held appeared in it and appeared whole. It was to be direct, substance present in its first clause. It was to be plainly worded, each thing called by the term in ordinary use. It was to run on for as long as the matter afforded something to say. Those four together had the writer {request}, and what was produced under them ran thus:

A perimeter runs round the text, and it has an inner side and an outer one. Inside lie the matter itself, whole, and whatever the matter cannot be stated without. Outside lie the adjacent questions, the class into which the matter falls, and every assessment of the whole. The near arc of the perimeter falls where the subject opens, the far arc where the subject closes. Between them the terms let whoever answers {request}, and the ground so enclosed reads on:

A drum of insulation tape stood at one corner, nearly spent, and beside it lay a lug crimped onto a stub of wire. The shelf above it carried no second block, and the tray held no ferrule of the gauge marked on the drum. What the tag tied through the lug had the respondent {request}, in the space ruled beneath the same line:

Nothing in this is narrative. There is no scene, no persons standing in one, no train of events, no place, and no lapse of time across which anything might be said to move. Nothing is described, nothing is recounted, and nothing is implied to lie out of sight beyond the wording. What remains once all of that is set aside is the thing asked for, and the thing asked for makes whoever replies {request}, plainly, and at the length it needs:

Two things are asked of the form: that the matter appear whole, and that it appear in words already in common use. The answer specified is one that sets out to {request}. The answer that follows carries both properties from its first word onward:

The bounds were narrow ones: the matter itself lay within them, and whatever stood next to it lay beyond. Between those two edges the whole of what was asked was to {request}. Nothing beyond the far side was taken in, and the enclosed run continued:
